title: Referee Bias Analysis
text:
Approach
Built three increasingly complex GLM/GLMM models, checking whether findings held up as complexity increased. Used this project to refresh R skills after a multi-year break working mainly in Python.

title: Referee Bias Analysis
text:
Status
Write-up in progress. A next step is extending the analysis to yellow cards as an additional outcome variable.

title: Sannakate
text:
I’m a data scientist based in Copenhagen, with a background spanning financial administration, process coordination, and healthcare before moving into data science. I recently completed my MSc in Data Science at ITU Copenhagen, where my thesis examined chain-of-thought reasoning faithfulness in LLMs.
I’m currently looking for data science and research-focused roles in the Copenhagen area.
